svg.title: Constructive plate boundary: mid-ocean ridge
svg.desc: Two oceanic plates move apart at a mid-ocean ridge: magma rises from the mantle into a magma chamber and up through the rift valley to form new oceanic crust, so the sea floor spreads. Bands of normal and reversed magnetic polarity in the crust are the same on both sides of the ridge, with the youngest rock at the ridge.

g.text: and erupts on the sea floor
youngest rock is at the ridge
